raw.query: WITH latency AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, n_requests, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'ttft') AS ttft_p99_ms, MAX(p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'itl') AS itl_p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND run_id = 'riders:fc_lead60' GROUP BY run_id, window_name, n_requests), bounds AS (SELECT MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'ttft' AND bound_stat = 'p99') AS ttft_bound_ms, MAX(bound_ms) FILTER (WHERE sla_metric = 'itl' AND bound_stat = 'p99') AS itl_bound_ms FROM provenance.v_sla_bound) SELECT l.run_id, l.window_name, l.n_requests, d.window_requests, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, p.is_superseded, p.probe_kind, p.forecast_req_scale, p.implied_r_tail, l.ttft_p99_ms, l.itl_p99_ms, b.ttft_bound_ms, b.itl_bound_ms, (l.ttft_p99_ms <= b.ttft_bound_ms AND l.itl_p99_ms <= b.itl_bound_ms) AS pass_recomputed, p.passes AS pass_stored FROM latency l JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = l.run_id AND d.is_current = true LEFT JOIN provenance.v_riders_probe_config p ON p.run_id = l.run_id CROSS JOIN bounds b ORDER BY l.window_name
